caption: A Nahua depiction of teonanácatl ("flesh of the gods") mushroom-eating, Codex Magliabechiano, folio 90r.
alt: Colonial-period Nahua manuscript painting of a seated figure holding a mushroom to their mouth while a dark, clawed spirit figure stands over them, hand raised.
credit: Wikimedia Commons, from the Loubat facsimile of the Codex Magliabechiano (via FAMSI)
note: Contextual image, not a page of Schultes's article: it is a 16th-century Nahua depiction of teonanácatl-eating from the Codex Magliabechiano, cropped from the full folio, chosen because Schultes's 1940 paper is about exactly this practice.
